directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Hey, Sidorovich, I brought you something.
entries.JA_current: Hey, Sidorovich, I brought you something.
entries.JA_new: よお、シドロヴィッチ。いいものを持ってきたぞ。

entries.EN: What have you got there? Better not be a waste of time!
entries.JA_current: What have you got there? Better not be a waste of time!
entries.JA_new: 何を持ってきた？ 無駄足じゃないだろうな？

entries.EN: You know that robbery you suffered some time ago? Well, I think I know who was truly responsible. Take a look at this notebook. It belonged to a rookie named Fedka who organized the whole thing. That outcast outside the camp had nothing to do with it, he was also a victim and took the blame. Wolf can confirm that.
entries.JA_current: You know that robbery you suffered some time ago? Well, I think I know who was truly responsible. Take a look at this notebook. It belonged to a rookie named Fedka who organized the whole thing. That outcast outside the camp had nothing to do with it, he was also a victim and took the blame. Wolf can confirm that.
entries.JA_new: 少し前にあった盗難の件だ。誰が本当にやったのか分かったと思う。このノートを見てくれ。フェドカという新米のものだ。あいつが計画を立てた。キャンプの外にいる追放者は関係ない。巻き込まれて、罪をかぶっただけだ。ウルフも証言してくれる。

entries.EN: Holy shit! So you found the bastard?! Who would've thought... Where is he now!? I'm fixing to have a long chat with that Fedka bastard!
entries.JA_current: Holy shit! So you found the bastard?! Who would've thought... Where is he now!? I'm fixing to have a long chat with that Fedka bastard!
entries.JA_new: なんてこった！ あのろくでなしを見つけたのか！？ まさか……今どこにいる！？ フェドカの野郎とじっくり話をつけてやる！

entries.EN: It seems a bloodsucker has already had a chat with him about it.
entries.JA_current: It seems a bloodsucker has already had a chat with him about it.
entries.JA_new: もうブラッドサッカーが、あいつと話をつけたみたいだ。

entries.EN: Oh, yeah? Well, good riddance to him, that thief!... Wait, here he writes that he wanted to sell my stuff to some Vovan. Do you know who this guy is?
entries.JA_current: Oh, yeah? Well, good riddance to him, that thief!... Wait, here he writes that he wanted to sell my stuff to some Vovan. Do you know who this guy is?
entries.JA_new: そうか？ まあ、あの盗人が消えてせいせいした……待てよ、ここには俺の品をヴォヴァンって奴に売ろうとしてたと書いてある。そいつが誰か知ってるか？

entries.EN: No, it's the first time I've heard of him.
entries.JA_current: No, it's the first time I've heard of him.

entries.EN: Well, you've got amnesia anyway... Okay, let me check my address book. I keep a record of some of my clients, maybe there's something about him... Yeah, there's a "Vovan from the dark valley" who came to see me once... Marked One, please, check it out when you can and see if my loot is there! They took away my hard-earned stuff, the bastards, I'm virtually penniless here! Help an old trader out! Find that Vovan, take my stuff from him if it's there and bring it back to me. I'll pay you back properly!
entries.JA_current: Well, you've got amnesia anyway... Okay, let me check my address book. I keep a record of some of my clients, maybe there's something about him... Yeah, there's a "Vovan from the dark valley" who came to see me once... Marked One, please, check it out when you can and see if my loot is there! They took away my hard-earned stuff, the bastards, I'm virtually penniless here! Help an old trader out! Find that Vovan, take my stuff from him if it's there and bring it back to me. I'll pay you back properly!
entries.JA_new: そりゃそうだ、お前は記憶をなくしてるからな……よし、顧客名簿を見てみる。何人かは記録してある。そいつのことも載ってるかもしれん……ああ、「ダークバレーのヴォヴァン」って奴が一度来たことがあるな……印付き、時間がある時にそいつを探して、俺の盗品があるか確かめてくれ！ 苦労して手に入れた品を持っていかれた。あのろくでなしどもめ、俺はほとんど一文無しだ！ 商売人を助けてくれ！ ヴォヴァンを見つけて、俺の品があったら取り戻して持ってきてくれ。きっちり礼はする！

entries.EN: Why not, I'll try to find it.
entries.JA_current: Why not, I'll try to find it.
entries.JA_new: いいだろう。探してみる。

entries.EN: Glad to hear! But hurry up, or that bastard will sell out all my stuff. What are you standing around for? Go look for Vovan. I'm losing money every second because of you. And hurry up! That's my money he's taking in his pocket!
entries.JA_current: Glad to hear! But hurry up, or that bastard will sell out all my stuff. What are you standing around for? Go look for Vovan. I'm losing money every second because of you. And hurry up! That's my money he's taking in his pocket!
entries.JA_new: 助かる！ だが急げ。あのろくでなしに全部売り払われるぞ。何をぼさっとしてる？ ヴォヴァンを探せ。お前がここで時間を潰してる間にも、俺は損してるんだ。急げよ！ 奴は俺の金を懐に入れようとしてるんだぞ！
